fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-08-29 (night, 01:50): A black motorcycle bearing registration number TN-57-XX-1042 belonging to the complainant was taken from Neithal Garden Apartment Complex in Salem. Contact details given by the complainant, Dharani Prakash, include the number 9000000213. A witness, Karthik Rajan, reachable on 9000000091, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Rajesh Chandran may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000486. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Motorcycle allegedly driven away after the lock was forced.
